status: FROZEN BEFORE ANY v10 PAIR WAS SCORED

dataset.source: benchmark/corpus/fresh_programs (never placed in a v8/v9 split; never scored)
dataset.label_validation: dynamic oracle (return/exception/arg-mutation/stdout) on protocol inputs; EQ == base, CH(SC) != base, CH == SC-mutant

Dev: +0.0001 and +0.0316 -> technically met; both CIs include 0 (see V4_DEV_EVALUATION.json). V6 therefore enters v10 as an EXPERIMENTAL arm; V5 remains the primary method.
models: fitted on v9c train only (V10_MODELS_FROZEN.json); thresholds = Youden on v9c train
scoring: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 python experiments/final/score_v6_experimental.py --design v10 --split test (per-program subprocesses; frozen extraction; V5 and V6 from the same traces)
no_tuning_rule: nothing may be changed after scoring; evaluate_v10.py run refuses unless these hashes and FREEZE_V10_SCORED.json match; a single run only; a failure is reported, not re-run with changes
